question.text: Between positive and negative skew, prudent investors prefer:

answer.text: Zero skewness (normal), with positive skew as second-best

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.2.4.2, investors prefer zero skew; if any skew, positive is preferred because large negative outliers signal risk. The Trap: Negative skew carries tail risk; skew is material. Cross-Exam Context: Tested in XV/X-A portfolio theory. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Screen fund historical returns for negative-skew red flags before recommending.
